use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use Step = (x: int, y: int)

steps_of_length(squared: int) -> List[Step] is
    let found = LIST[Step]()
    let a mut = 0

    while 2 * a * a <= squared do
        let rest = cast double(squared - a * a)
        let b = cast int(Math.round(Math.sqrt(rest)))

        if a * a + b * b == squared then
            for (x, y) in [(a, b), (b, a)] do
                for (sx, sy) in [(1, 1), (-1, 1), (1, -1), (-1, -1)] do
                    found.add((x = sx * x, y = sy * y))
                od
            od
        fi

        a = a + 1
    od

    found
si

bend(from: Step, to: Step) -> double =>
    let turn = Math.atan2(cast double(from.y), cast double(from.x)) -
        Math.atan2(cast double(to.y), cast double(to.x)) in
    turn - 2.0D * Math.pi * Math.floor(turn / (2.0D * Math.pi))

spiral(count: int) -> List[Step] is
    let points = LIST[Step]([(x = 0, y = 0), (x = 0, y = 1)])
    let last: Step mut = (x = 0, y = 1)
    let squared mut = 1

    while points.count < count do
        let candidates mut = LIST[Step]()

        while candidates.count == 0 do
            squared = squared + 1
            candidates = steps_of_length(squared)
        od

        let from = last

        last = candidates
            |> reduce(candidates[0], (best, next) =>
                if bend(from, next) < bend(from, best) then next
                else best fi)

        let here = points[points.count - 1]

        points.add((x = here.x + last.x, y = here.y + last.y))
    od

    points
si

let first = spiral(40)

write_line("the first 40 points:")

for row in 0..4 do
    write_line(
        first
            |> skip(row * 10)
            |> take(10)
            |> map(p => "({p.x}, {p.y})")
            |> join(" "))
od

let many = spiral(10000)

let xs = many |> map(p => cast double(p.x)) |> collect_list()
let ys = many |> map(p => cast double(p.y)) |> collect_list()

let low_x = xs |> reduce(0.0D, Math.min)
let high_x = xs |> reduce(0.0D, Math.max)
let low_y = ys |> reduce(0.0D, Math.min)
let high_y = ys |> reduce(0.0D, Math.max)

let middle_x = (low_x + high_x) / 2.0D
let middle_y = (low_y + high_y) / 2.0D
let half = Math.max(high_x - low_x, high_y - low_y) * 0.52D

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)

image.view(
    middle_x - half, middle_y - half, middle_x + half, middle_y + half)
image.clear(252ub, 250ub, 245ub)
image.colour(30ub, 60ub, 140ub)
image.stroke(1.0D)
image.line(
    many |> map(p => (x = cast double(p.x), y = cast double(p.y)))
        |> collect_list())

image.write("spiral.png")

image.show("spiral.png")
